limits: This bundle covers only stage one (4 of 16 lessons); later marketing stages remain outlines.
The 2026 synthetic-response study is limited to the questions, samples and models examined; it does not establish that all synthetic methods fail or work.
University curriculum pages support topic alignment and do not indicate endorsement or access to proprietary classroom content.
Expert review, fresh equivalent questions and learner pilot remain pending.
